criteria.text: Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy (NVP) in women who do not respond to conservative management
Documented trial and failure of at least one conservative management regimen for nausea and vomiting
No concurrent MAO inhibitor use: Diclegis and Bonjesta are contraindicated with concurrent MAO inhibitors

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Diclegis / Bonjesta criteria, effective 2022-04-15. Both products contain doxylamine succinate + pyridoxine HCl: Diclegis 10 mg/10 mg; Bonjesta 20 mg/20 mg.
Encoded: NVP indication, documented trial and failure of at least one conservative management regimen, and exclusion of concurrent MAOI use.
Authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for up to 3 months.

Product-specific quantity limits (notes only): Diclegis 120 tablets per 30 days; Bonjesta 60 tablets per 30 days. Quantity enforcement requires manual review; max_units is null to avoid a shared product limit.
Remains partial: diagnosis and treatment history are attestations; evidence verification, authorization duration and product-specific quantities require manual review. PDL status unknown.
